calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-02-23' AS start_date, DATE '2026-03-22' AS end_date
),
weekly_stock AS (
    -- step 1: sum closing_value across products within each week, category, and store
    SELECT fs.week_ending_date, cp.category,
           SUM(fs.closing_value) AS weekly_closing_value
    FROM fact_stock_week fs
    JOIN dim_store s    ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
    JOIN dim_store cs   ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN dim_product p  ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
      AND cs.region = 'West'
      AND cs.store_id < 900 
      AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
-- step 2: average across weeks by category
SELECT category,
       ROUND(AVG(weekly_closing_value), 2) AS avg_stock_value
FROM weekly_stock
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
